positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer - Staff Engineer II
positions.description: Cloud Management, Service Extensibility, Content Management & Transfer, Container Registry, Kubernetes, Operators.

positions.title: Computer Scientist
positions.description:
•	Lead the global URL project to unify hosted domains across multiple hosted clusters including DNS SOAP web service integration. 
•	Lead developer to build a pay-per-minute conferencing integration subsystem by developing a global account provisioning server for multiple hosted clusters across regions. 
•	Lead several Connect Pro server re-architect features: meeting subsystem integration, auxiliary service server, meeting template redesign.
•	Lead several core features for Connect Pro 7 server including multiple telephony adaptor support, telephony token merge using Java and Flex/Flash.
•	Developed several meeting room features, audio bridge emulator and automation test framework to integrate two complex enterprise-level conferencing applications. 
•	Member of the development team that built a converged SIP communication client using C++, Flex/Flash, and ACE framework.

Skills: Java, Flex/Flash, Spring, JMS, JMX, Hibernate, C++, SaaS, telephony/VOIP, SOAP/REST
